name: I Will Not Drink With You Today

mentions.name: I Will Not Drink With You Today
mentions.description: A daily reader on sobriety and stillness, released as a book with a companion website. The book was written in markdown, stored in a SQLite DB, and parsed into static JSON so the site loads very fast. Marketing and organic growth are being treated like a startup, with readings from the book shared on Instagram and TikTok.
